The push includes the possibility for parents to choose their child’s airplane seat at no extra cost; allowing flyers to bring for free a on-board personal item and small hand luggage; and making sure that passengers whose trips combine different transport types – for example a flight, a train journey and a bus connection – get better support in case of missed connections due to delays or cancellations.
